description: WoBike is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Mobility and Transportation", published or maintained by ubahnverleih (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Public transport and multimodal routing apps could benefit from showing nearby bikes from bikesharing services. So here's a list showing the APIs of a few of these platforms. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Mobility and Transportation" (mobility and transport). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
